config.frozen_note: pre-registered; do not tune k, alpha, metric selection, or structure against the 2019-2025 evaluation period
inherits_from_phase3: feature windows (season_to_date / trailing_3 / trailing_5 / prior_season) + min-sample bars
horizons [1, 2, 4]; PRIMARY status horizons = [2, 4]; H1 stays a diagnostic
season_phase_buckets (early 1-4, wk5_9, wk10_14, wk15_18); primary weeks 5-18

inherits_from_phase3.bootstrap: multiplier cluster (entity_id x season), 1000 iterations, 95% percentile CI

shrinkage.formula: shrunk = league_mean + w * (raw - league_mean);  w = n / (n + k)

k_selection.training_window: all observations with target season < OOS season S (includes 2016-2018)
k_selection.objective: pooled RMSE(shrunk_k, target) over primary weeks 5-18, horizons 2 and 4
k_selection.freeze: chosen k frozen before season S is scored

opponent_adjustment.model: ridge regression: per-(entity, game) metric ~ entity one-hot + opponent one-hot + home
opponent_adjustment.adjusted_strength: intercept + entity coefficient (opponent + home effects removed), then centred to mean 0 across entities in the fit
opponent_adjustment.fit_window: completed games with data_asof < target kickoff, trailing 2 seasons

alpha_selection.training_window: target seasons 2016-2018 (all strictly before the 2019-2025 evaluation period)
alpha_selection.objective: pooled next-game (H1) RMSE of the opponent-adjusted strength vs actual next-game metric, primary weeks
alpha_selection.freeze: chosen alpha frozen for the entire evaluation period
alpha_selection.disclosed_deviation: alpha is selected ONCE per (family, metric) on 2016-2018 and frozen for all of 2019-2025, rather than re-selected before each OOS season, for tractability. Still chosen strictly from pre-evaluation data. The ridge STRENGTHS are still refit walk-forward every (season, week).

normalization.note: z-normalization is an affine transform per prediction date; it does not change rankings and is not itself a source of predictive information (confirmed Phase 3).

placebo.name: phase3_placebo
placebo.method: within-season feature permutation (feature and target season-centred), as Phase 3

randomized_opponents.name: randomized_opponent_labels
randomized_opponents.method: permute opponent identities in the ridge design matrix; the opponent-adjusted feature's advantage over the raw/shrunk feature must vanish

hyperparameter_rules: k and alpha are hyperparameters; selected ONLY inside the historical training window per fold
never choose k or alpha from aggregate 2019-2025 results
the 2019-2025 OOS evaluation period is untouched by any tuning

adds_value_requires: skill vs the reference layer's feature: 95% CI lower bound > 0
skill vs the reference layer's feature: point estimate >= economic_floor_skill

forbidden: matchup_interactions (offense x defense, pass rush x protection, QB x rush, run x run, explosive x explosive)
